name: OpenStation
description: Brand tokens for OpenStation, the open-source WordPress plugin that turns wp-admin into a desktop OS.

pulse.$description: Pulse. Neon identity accent, formerly named Pulsar. RGB 242, 82, 252. HSL 296, 97, 65.

nebula.$description: Nebula. Soft identity accent. RGB 236, 155, 255. HSL 289, 100, 80.

starlight.$description: Starlight. Light contrast color. RGB 255, 251, 255. HSL 300, 100, 99.

sirius.$description: Sirius. Aqua contrast accent. RGB 194, 241, 241. HSL 180, 63, 85.

obsidian.$description: Obsidian. Surface dark, replaces the former Astro #19161E. RGB 26, 23, 33. HSL 258, 18, 11.

void.$description: Void. Darkest brand color, base background. RGB 12, 11, 15. HSL 255, 15, 5.

gray.$description: Shade palette: a ten-step secondary grays ramp from Void to Starlight. Void, Obsidian and Starlight are shared with the primary palette.

holomesh.$description: Holomesh. Holographic mesh gradient (lavender, pink, cyan, mint) for hero surfaces, backgrounds and CTAs, defined in Figma as a vector gradient fill: a lavender base linear (#AFA2E8 to #C3B8EF) with eight radial glows. Never used as a background behind the logo: the mark can carry a holo fill, but there is no knocked-out logo on Holomesh.

pulsemesh.$description: Pulsemesh. Pulsar-style mesh gradient (magenta, pink, cyan, white) for hero surfaces, defined in Figma as a vector gradient fill: a violet base linear (#A98EF0 to #C776F2) with five radial glows. Formerly named Pulsarmesh.

space.$description: Space. Quiet deep-space backdrop: a linear gradient from #010101 through #111114 to #1E1D23. The default dark background behind content.

galaxy.$description: Galaxy. Hero background: Void base with soft Nebula glows and a Starlight starfield (bright, dim and large star layers).

sans.$description: Everything human: headlines, UI copy, body text.

mono.$description: The instrument voice: labels, metadata, statuses, code. Small, uppercase, letterspaced.

scale.$description: Typographic scale from the Figma Typography section. Line height 1.4 across all levels.

appIcon.$value: 25/120 of icon size (rounded square), or a full circle

rules: The name is OpenStation, one word, capital O and capital S.
The logoword is the name set in Geist SemiBold (600), sentence case, no added tracking.
Lockup proportions: the logomark's height is 5/3 of the logoword's font size (a 40px mark next to 24px type), the gap between them is half the font size, and both center on the same axis.
The wordmark is used in all references to the product as space allows; monochrome usage is preferred, with the brand colors as accents.
When referring to OpenStation as a product (social media, the plugins page, app listings), always add the chip: the mark sits on its Void app tile, never bare.
The standalone mark has two flat fills: Starlight, or the Holomesh holographic gradient (a vector gradient stack baked into the holo SVGs). No shadows or effects outside the app icons.
Holomesh is for backgrounds, CTAs and surfaces, never a background behind the logo: the knocked-out (negative) logo on Holomesh is not part of the system.

App icon: Void (#0C0B0F) tile, rounded square (radius 25/120 of the icon size) or circle, with a soft white inner shadow; the mark fills the central 3/5 of the tile (1/5 margin on each side). Inside the icon the mark gets the dimensional treatment: the Pearl radial fill (Starlight to Cloud) or Holomesh, a Mist edge stroke, a soft halo ring, stacked drop shadows and an inner highlight, all baked into the SVGs. Always on Void; there is no inverted or holo-background app icon.

mascot.name: Mio
mascot.description: A small ghost blob that lives aboard the station: it glows in Pulse, drifts between windows, and shows up where the interface has something to say.
mascot.status: Final form, expressions, poses and usage rules to be defined.

license.summary: OpenStation is an open-source WordPress plugin (GPL). Brand assets are meant to be reused; fonts are SIL OFL 1.1.
